articles.summary: CHICAGO, April 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Rush Street Interactive, Inc. (NYSE: RSI) (“RSI”) today announced that it will release its first quarter 2026 results after the market close on Tuesday, April 28, 2026, followed by a conference call at 6:00 pm Eastern Time (5:00 pm Central Time) to discuss the results. RSI’s earnings press release and related materials will be available at ir.rushstreetinteractive.com . To listen to the audio webcast and live QA, please visit RSI’s investor relations website at ir.rushstreetinteractive.com . Interested parties may also dial 1-833-461-5787 (Toll Free) or 1-585-542-9983 (Local) or, for international callers, please reference https://help.events.q4inc.com/eahc/international-dial-in-numbers . The conference call access code is 722298233. An audio replay of the webcast will be available on RSI’s investor relations website shortly after the call until at least May 31, 2026.
